about: The author's regression song. 'original' is the song as first written; 'fixed' is the corrected line, which is canonical from now on. Each original must produce 'expect' (rule ids, by phase); each fixed line must pass with no errors or warnings. English marked 'derived' was written from the dictionary glosses because the song arrived without it; the author's own wording is used for lines 2 and 14. Line 16 arrived cut off and is completed from the author's fix table.

lines.original: kube krono po lombila, maivo po surusia baba faruti.
lines.fixed: kube krono po lombila, maivo po surusia baba faruti.
lines.english: When time began, I felt a little fire.

lines.original: mareasasan velu po savalisia maivo su li lehe.
lines.fixed: maresan velu po savalisia maivo su li lehe.
lines.english: A mother star kissed me on the cheek.

superseded.why: 2.0 reglossed mareasasan as 'mothering all generations' (ADR-0016), which now matches the English 'A mother star', so the checker cannot see the drift from the English. The fixed line, maresan, still passes.

lines.original: saivo po senosia en baba melosan valla.
lines.fixed: saivo po senosia yuta baba melosan valla.
lines.english: They spoke in a musical voice.

lines.original: ramumomvira taivo de lumiasasan kronobio ne.
lines.fixed: nuna-krono ramumomvira taivo de lumiasasan kronobio.

lines.original: taivo de nalfari donuda suma ala li navuri.
lines.fixed: taivo de nalfari donuda suma ala li navuri.
lines.english: Your wings give warmth to the skies.

lines.original: taivo vagava hupi li sabesan lanla.
lines.fixed: taivo diyida hupi li sabesan lanla.
lines.english: You fly above the familiar horizon.

lines.original: li luno salrusia ata taivo somusia en maivo de varori.
lines.fixed: li luno salrusia ata taivo somusia en maivo de varori.
lines.english: The moon rises and you sleep in my arms.

lines.original: maivo de navuasasan faru donuda taivo polva.
lines.fixed: maivo de navuasasan faru donuda taivo polva.
lines.english: My celestial fire gives you power.

lines.original: maivo de savali su taivo de lehe donuda taivo opi.
lines.fixed: maivo de savali, raho ke su taivo de lehe, donuda taivo opi.
lines.english: My kiss on your cheek gives you hope.

lines.original: maivo de lomo senosia ala taivo fime taivo ke nimu.
lines.fixed: maivo de lomo senosia ala taivo fime taivo ke nimusan.
lines.english: My embrace tells you that you are at home.

lines.original: faruti, taivo de corvi farlafa maivo milobe.
lines.fixed: faruti, taivo de corvi vaku maivo milobema.
lines.english: Little fire, your courage makes me smile.

lines.original: lirala maivo baba somulira su li suma de narvonasan faru.
lines.fixed: lirala baba somulira vobi maivo su li suma de narvonasan faru.
lines.english: Sing me a lullaby on the warmth of the innocent fire.

lines.original: taivo po ke gonbihemlusan ala li suma de maivo de yuge.
lines.fixed: taivo ke gonbihemlusan ala li suma de maivo de yuge.
lines.english: You are invited to the warmth of my body.

lines.original: fisa lavbu gase taivo venreva ala maivo de lumiasasan pago.
lines.fixed: fisa, lavbula nayo taivo venreva ala maivo de lumiasasan pago.
lines.english: Please pray as you come to my holy place.

lines.original: ata maivo futu lisila taivo ko maivo de mavolumisan miru.
lines.fixed: ata maivo futu lisila taivo yuta maivo de mavolumisan miru.
lines.english: And I will anoint you with my soulful water.
